rules.rule: Bronze Account: 2.0% APY and only 6 free withdrawals. It fails a need of more than 6 withdrawals per month.
rules.quote: Free withdrawals per month: 6

rules.rule: Silver Account: 4.0% at $10,000 or more. Only 10 free withdrawals (15 with a Platinum Rewards Card, which costs $200 a year).
rules.quote: Track your withdrawal activity; transactions beyond 10 in a cycle may incur an excess withdrawal fee as described in your account disclosures.

rules.rule: Green Account (savings): 4.0% and 8 withdrawals (15 with an EcoCard)
rules.quote: Plan withdrawals to stay within 8 each month.

rules.rule: Silver Plus Account: 4.5% Tier 2 at $15,000 or more, 15 free withdrawals. Best card bonus is EcoCard +0.45%, then Gold Rewards Card +0.2%.
rules.quote: Tier 2 APY: 4.5% for balances at or above the Tier 2 threshold.

rules.rule: Gold Account: 5.5% APY, 20 withdrawals, $10,000 minimum balance. Card bonuses: EcoCard +0.6%, Green Rewards Card +0.35%, Gold Rewards Card +0.025%.
rules.quote: You can make up to 20 withdrawals per month.

rules.rule: Gold Plus Account: 6.0% APY
rules.quote: APY: 6.0% percent on eligible balances in this tier.

rules.rule: Gold Plus Account: at least $10,000 to open
rules.quote: Fund the account with at least $10,000 at opening.

rules.quote: The minimum balance requirement is $25,000. If your balance falls below this amount, a monthly maintenance fee of $15.00 may apply.

rules.rule: Gold Plus Account: up to 25 withdrawals per month
rules.quote: Plan cash flows so you do not exceed 25 withdrawals in a month.

rules.rule: Gold Plus Account: the Gold Rewards Card gives +0.35%, the highest bonus for this account

rules.rule: Worked result for this profile (deposit $25,000–$49,999 kept all year; 16–25 withdrawals/month, or fewer; Rho-Bank+ active; no crypto; fee ceiling below $200; checking not in the boost list): Gold Plus Account + Gold Rewards Card, at 6.0% + 0.35% = 6.35% with a $0 fee. Alternatives: Gold Account + EcoCard (6.1% − $50); Silver Plus Account + EcoCard (4.95% − $50); Platinum Account + Gold Rewards Card (6.65% − $300 in fees below $50,000). All of these are lower.
